summary: ```# Marvelous Designer 2025.0 New Features Overview ## Introduction Welcome to the new feature introduction video of Marvelous Designer 2025. In this video, we will introduce you to the new version of the Marvelous Designer 2025 model. ## Overall Display Let's start by taking a look at the overall display. There are two different components: 1. The first component is the cool screen, and the color is nice and golden. 2. The second component is also that cool screen, and the color is nice and golden. ## Asset Categories In the window, the assets are classified into the following categories: - Clothing - Virtual Models - Objects - Accessories - Scenes Click on the preview bar in the upper right corner to open the preview interface and view the preview of the file. There is an asset bar under each category where you can find your default assets. ## Connect Asset Category In addition, there is also a Connect Asset category, which includes the assets sold in the official mall. When you click on the free option, the assets displayed are free assets. If you cancel the free option, you can browse and purchase more paid products. You can check the purchase page of the shop on the website to see the products you have purchased. ## Closet Platform You can also visit the Closet platform in the new library window. Closet is a cloud platform that can be used to upload, share, and manage your 3D assets. We can download the project files that were previously uploaded from Closet. Then, go to the shop page to check and add the assets needed. Here, I searched for an oversized top and added it to the 3D window. And here it is. ## Layout Adjustments Once you've read the manual and found the right task, you can use the 3D window to read the layout. You can also change the size of your 3D wall and make the wall a little smaller. You can change the location of the new clothes by adding layers to the new clothes. This allows the clothes to move quickly and circle out. Next, we will remove the button that holds the outer clothes and adjust the layout of the shirt. ## Fabric Selection After wearing it, we can browse the fabric in the store and select the fabric we like to apply it to the clothing. You can also browse other digital assets according to your needs to call them. ## Creating an Asset Library You can also build your own asset library to manage assets more effectively. Click on the "Create New Asset Library" button at the top of the menu. Then, click on "Add Asset," and select the asset on your computer. Now, we will save the asset to the asset we just added. Then, click on the refresh button to view the content saved in the asset. You can manage your assets through these documents. ```
